integrity.proof_type: self-contained algebraic proof using elementary quadratic Gauss-sum identities and Weyl orthogonality
integrity.verification: finite independent FFT, quadratic-sum, exact congruence-pattern, and direct SVD cross-checks; no independent external validation

scientific_limitations: For primes at least five and exponent one, ambiguity is proved zero-free, but no sharp minimum singular value is claimed.
Dyadic rank deficiency is only a failure of linear informational completeness, not a proof of noninjective pure-state phase retrieval.
Only the fixed cubic chirp with a unit positive impulse is studied; no universal optimality or full-spark property is claimed.
Floating point verification corroborates but does not constitute the general proof. Absolute bibliographic novelty remains uncertain.
title: Parity and prime-power conditioning of one-spike cubic chirp tomography
